brief: GS's European equities sales note: US equities fell for a sixth straight session (SPX -202bps to 7175, 11/11 sectors down, VIX +16% to 28.47), the AI trade reversing early strength (AI Semis basket -2.91%, Data Center basket -2.29%) while NDX stayed up 5% YTD and RTY fell -218bps. Positioning: Industrials is the second most net-sold US sector MTD with net exposure at a 2-year low; Consumer Staples is also heavily sold, fading its rally. Asset managers and hedge funds sold macro products while buying consumer/financials pockets; liquidity is poor (S&P top-of-book averaging $4mm). Large-cap mutual funds (42% beating benchmarks YTD) stayed 722bp underweight the Mag 7 through Q3, which cushioned recent AI-complex weakness, while overweighting Industrials, Health Care and Financials. Fundamental L/S hedge funds are down -0.2% in November (+8.9% YTD), net selling equities long-and-short near 3:1 and cutting leverage to a 5-year low, with CTA selling adding to the move. Separately: GS reiterates Buy on AstraZeneca, Bayer, Argenx (CL), Galderma and UCB; Sell on Novartis over patent-cliff risk. Also: Vår Energi cut to Neutral (PT NOK70 to NOK51); Schindler Sell; FLSmidth Buy reiterated as contrarian; Rational Buy (PT EUR833).
